notes.title: Update Version 1.04.x.b210228
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.04.x.b210228 ːsteamthisː [/h1]
[list]
[*]NEW: Disabled <>:"/\|?* characters when entering export file name.
[*]FIXED: When loading a backup song, the backup will overwrite while loading samples.
[*]FIXED: User samples were not cleared when loading song from ROM.
[*]FIXED: if there's no space on the cloud, then the error message: "WRONG SONG NAME".
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31070681/827259f6d6d77270a3790969cc12d8d26fa4b2bf.png[/img]
[h1]Version 1.031.x.b200506 ːsteamthisː [/h1]
[i]On the release of the 1.03 update, we forgot to send information about what this update contains. We're fixing our mistake.[/i]
[list]
[*]NEW: Adjust the logic of a song backup in progress (when the application is closed).The new system is safer and should cause fewer problems.
[*]NEW: During visualization there is a new key shortcut (shift+space) that triggers the play preview of the selected song.
[*]NEW: If you change the quality of the graphic you no longer see the alert box about resolution.
[*]FIXED: Screen resolution change did not work in fullscreen.
[*]FIXED: Backup file is not loaded again if it was found to be corrupted.
[*]FIXED: Minor graphics errors.
[/list]
[h1]What's next for Rytmik Studio?[/h1]
[list]
[*]We plan to complete documentation and close Early Access later this year and continue support - repair bugs and add minor improvements
[*]We are also now working on a new DLC for Rytmik Studio, details will be announced soon
[*]We would also like to start featuring selected songs from active Rytmik users on YouTube
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.84.2.b80727
notes.notes:
Version 0.84.2.b80727

[list]
[*]NEW: added key short-cuts: Home, End - move song cursor to start/end of the song
[*]NEW: added key short-cuts: Page Up, Page Down - move song cursor one page right/left
[*]NEW: added key short-cuts: Arrow Up - move song cursor to next song marker (same as W key)
[*]NEW: added key short-cuts: Arrow Down - move song cursor to previous song marker or to the start (same as S key)
[*]NEW: added key short-cuts: Arrow Right - move song cursor one step right (same as D key)
[*]NEW: added key short-cuts: Arrow Left - move song cursor one step left (same as A key)
[*]NEW: song scrolling now adjusts its speed acording to distance of view from cursor
[*]NEW: Delete comment in song browser
[*]NEW: control + mouse on song name or author name in Song browser sets song filter
[*]NEW: some minor bug fixes

[*][b]NEW: RYTMIK LIVE (DLC will be released 7th of August 2018, now available for Backers)[/b]

[*]FIX: sidechain was not working properly for song Preview
[*]FIX: there was wrong clip playback when song Preview andvanced to the next song
[*]FIX: some key-short cuts for song browser were active even if browser was closed
[*]FIX: MIDI CC was not working correctly in Clip Editor
[*]FIX: Mousewheel was not working correctly in Clip Editor
[*]FIX: With Clip Song mode on now flawlessly swicth between Song and Clip editor
[*]FIX: Song plays are not counted for users own songs
[*]FIX: metronome in Clip Editor was not working correctly
[*]FIX: Live Space and Live Trance Trumpet songs with Live setup added to ROM
[/list]

notes.title: Rytmik Live and Rytmik Studio update
notes.notes:
At this moment we are working on DLC Rytmik Live. Rytmik Live will be released on 7th of August and with this release we will also release new version of Rytmik Studio. Also we are working on video preview of Rytmik Live. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Version 0.72.2.b80524 – Steel drum & Bagpipes
notes.notes:
Version 0.72.2.b80524 – Steel drum & Bagpipes
[list]
[*]NEW: audio buffer size can be set up to 32768 (simmilar to previous Large buffer setting). Use higher buffer sizes to avoid audio dropouts on machines with slower CPU.
[*]NEW: Added Samples of Steel drum to WORLD/MALLET bank. Added two Steel drum presets.
[*]NEW: Added Samples of Bagpipes to WORLD/BOWWIND bank. Added two Bagpipes presets.
[*]FIXED: Several bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.71.1.b80510 – Live recording
notes.notes:
Version 0.71.1.b80510 – Live recording
[list]
[*]NEW: Sound engine is reworked to achieve much lower latency. Buffer size 4096 is equivalent to previous LOW buffer setting. Buffer sizes 1024 and lower should be usable for live recording.
[*]NEW: Live recording in Clip editor. With lower audio buffers it is possible to live record notes from MIDI or PC keyboard.
[*]NEW: Metronome. It is possible to use metronome in Clip editor for live recording.
[*]NEW: Over 100 new instrument presets.
[*]FIXED: Several bug fixes.
[/list]
